figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: SELECT id,CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS numeric_amount,CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='skin' THEN '护肤品' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='home' THEN '日用品' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='makeup' THEN '化妆品' ELSE '待分类' END AS clean_category FROM raw_data ORDER BY name DESC;
